```yaml
name: PR Status Labeler

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["capture-pr-data"]
    types:
      - completed
    filters:
      event:
        - pull_request
      head_repository:
        - ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  label-pr:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Download PR data artifact
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workflow: capture-pr-data
          name: pr-data
          path: ./pr-data

      - name: Read PR data
        id: read_pr
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(jq -r .pr_number ./pr-data/pr-data.json)
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Label PR
        uses: actions/labeler@v6
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          sync-labels: false
          pr-number: ${{ steps.read_pr.outputs.pr_number }}
```
